name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.8.6 widens the surface crossover ground from 8m to 11m to match the native approach profile. Platform dimensions, compact 5m head plaza, trees, flowers, native tram material layers, vehicle paths and underground station remain unchanged. The user confirmed passenger boarding with the compact plaza. Observed switch speed remains under investigation; configured speed values have not been changed speculatively. An optional separate read-only Speed Probe helper reports effective engine speed and curvature limits. The standard mod contains no automatic diagnostic hooks. Place a new surface station to inspect the wider switch underlay. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
